exposure: admission to neonatal intensive care unit after delivery
cohort: The study included 7134 live, singleton, term newborns registered in the Georgian Birth Registry in November and December 2017.
finding: Factors associated with nonexclusive breastfeeding at hospital discharge were maternal higher education, caesarean delivery, birthweight < 2500g, and admission to the neonatal intensive care unit.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was significantly associated with nonexclusive breastfeeding at hospital discharge compared to vaginal or assisted vaginal delivery (AOR 0.47; 95% CI 0.37, 0.60).
